caption:
India's factories just kept expanding - for yet another month. And export orders just hit a 6-month high.

India's Manufacturing PMI stood at 54.7 in October 2026, comfortably above the 50-mark that separates expansion from contraction. The headline number eased slightly from September, but new export orders grew at their fastest pace in six months - the strongest signal of external demand in the dataset.

A single number can hide what's actually happening underneath it. This month, the number eased - but the part that matters for exports just got stronger.

Sources: Trading Economics, Current Affairs Adda247, citing S&P Global/HSBC data (2026)
